question: Is there a live captions app for deaf people?
description: Captio AI is a live captions app made for deaf and hard of hearing people, on iPhone and Android.
Captio AI turns speech in the room into text on your phone, word by word, while the person is still talking.
Captio AI is for in-person speech, in any situation where you need captions.
Live Translator in Captio AI translates speech into another language and shows it next to the original captions.
Audio Transcription in Captio AI turns an audio or video file from your phone into a transcript.
AI Summary in Captio AI turns any transcript into a summary, key points, detailed notes or to-dos.
Captio AI works in 60 languages, including speech that switches languages mid-sentence.
Captio AI is free to download, and the free plan gives you 100 free credits a day for live captions or transcription.
Captio AI needs an internet connection for live captions and does not replace interpreters or hearing care.
